$comment: Per-document-type extraction/generation eval tasks. `candidateContent`/`candidateExtraction` let the runner score a captured output offline (no DB/LLM); `input` lets --live draft generation tasks through the AI gateway and score the result. Generation pass = section coverage >= min AND zero forbidden hits; extraction pass = field F1 >= min. Expand to 10+ tasks per docType with real source documents before treating the numbers as a quality bar.

tasks.input: Subject device: Acme Analyzer 2000, a benchtop in vitro diagnostic for quantitation of analyte X in serum. Predicate: K123456 (same intended use, same measurand, comparable technology). Bench studies completed: precision (CLSI EP05), linearity (EP06), method comparison (EP09) vs predicate. Labeling includes intended use, warnings, and instructions for use.
tasks.candidateContent: Device description: the subject device is a benchtop analyzer. Intended use: in vitro quantitation of analyte X. Substantial equivalence: the subject device has the same intended use and technological characteristics as the predicate (K123456). Performance testing: precision, linearity, and method comparison studies were conducted. Labeling: instructions for use and warnings are provided.

tasks.input: Device: implantable widget for condition Y. Clinical background and current standard of care described in literature. Evidence: a literature review and post-market clinical follow-up (PMCF) dataset appraised for relevance and methodological quality. Benefit-risk concluded acceptable for the intended population per MEDDEV 2.7/1 rev 4.
tasks.candidateContent: Clinical background: the device treats condition Y. State of the art: current standard of care is described. Clinical data appraisal: literature and PMCF data were appraised for relevance and quality. Benefit-risk: the benefit-risk profile is acceptable for the intended population. Conclusions: the clinical evidence supports conformity.

tasks.input: Program: first-in-human Phase 1 for indication Z. Nonclinical pharmacology and toxicology completed (rodent and non-rodent GLP studies). Clinical overview: single ascending dose design with safety run-in. Benefit-risk assessment for healthy volunteers documented.
tasks.candidateContent: Introduction: this is a Phase 1 program for indication Z. Nonclinical overview: pharmacology and toxicology summarized. Clinical overview: first-in-human design rationale provided. Benefit-risk assessment: the profile supports first-in-human dosing in healthy volunteers.

tasks.input: GLP toxicology package: repeat-dose toxicity in rat and dog, genotoxicity battery (Ames, micronucleus), safety pharmacology core battery (CNS, CV, respiratory). NOAEL established; safety margins calculated against the proposed clinical starting dose.
tasks.candidateContent: Study designs: GLP studies are described. Repeat-dose toxicity: rat and dog studies were conducted. Genotoxicity: Ames and micronucleus assays were negative. Safety pharmacology: CNS, CV, and respiratory endpoints were assessed. NOAEL and safety margins: the NOAEL supports the proposed clinical starting dose.
